# The Daily Beast

> > The Daily Beast delivers original reporting and sharp commentary on politics, media, entertainment, technology, and culture.

The Daily Beast is a leading online news publication known for investigative journalism, political analysis, and cultural criticism. The site also features The Looker, a dedicated vertical covering beauty, wellness, and lifestyle trends.

## Key Topics

- The Daily Beast
- Politics & Media
- Investigative Journalism
- Entertainment News
- Celebrity News
- The Looker
- Beauty & Wellness
- Technology & AI
- Cultural Criticism
- Social Issues
- Affirmative Action
- Product Reviews
- Lifestyle Trends
- Media Analysis

## Main Site

- [The Daily Beast: The Latest in Politics, Media & Entertainment News](https://thedailybeast.com): The Daily Beast homepage featuring politics, entertainment & celebrity news

## Politics & Investigative Reporting

- [Key Details of 13-Year-Old Trump Accuser's Accounts Are Verified](https://thedailybeast.com/key-details-of-13-year-old-trump-accusers-accounts-are-verified): FBI interviews verify details in Trump-Epstein sexual abuse allegations
- [Affirmative Action: Who Does it Help, Who Does it Hurt?](https://thedailybeast.com/affirmative-action-who-does-it-help-who-does-it-hurt): Analysis of affirmative action debate and University of Texas Supreme Court case
- [Airlines, Including Delta, to Add New Gender Options for Non-Binary Passengers](https://thedailybeast.com/airlines-including-delta-to-add-new-gender-options-for-non-binary-passengers): Airlines for America adds non-binary gender options for passenger bookings

## Media & Technology Analysis

- ['60 Minutes' Made a Shockingly Wrong Claim About a Google AI Chatbot](https://thedailybeast.com/60-minutes-made-a-shockingly-wrong-claim-about-googles-ai-chatbot-bard): Fact-check of 60 Minutes' claims about Google Bard's language abilities
- [Alex Jones' Protégé, Paul Joseph Watson, Is About to Steal His Crackpot Crown](https://thedailybeast.com/alex-jones-protege-paul-joseph-watson-is-about-to-steal-his-crackpot-crown): Profile of InfoWars' Paul Joseph Watson and conspiracy theory media

## Cultural Commentary

- [Antiracism, Our Flawed New Religion](https://thedailybeast.com/antiracism-our-flawed-new-religion): Cultural criticism examining antiracism as quasi-religious movement
- [What's the Deal With Bath Salts? FAQ on the Designer Drug](https://thedailybeast.com/whats-the-deal-with-bath-salts-faq-on-the-designer-drug): Explainer on bath salts designer drug containing MDPV and mephedrone

## The Looker: Beauty, Wellness & Lifestyle

- [The Looker - Beauty, Wellness, and Lifestyle News](https://thelooker.thedailybeast.com): Beauty, wellness & lifestyle vertical featuring product reviews & trends
- [Hot on the Scent? Here's a Breakdown of Every Fragrance Type Out There](https://thelooker.thedailybeast.com/each-type-of-fragrance-and-how-to-decide-which-to-buy): Guide to perfume concentrations from eau de cologne to extrait de parfum
- [Why Everyone Thinks They Can Decode Your Insecurities From Photos](https://thelooker.thedailybeast.com/why-everyone-thinks-they-can-decode-your-insecurities-from-photos): Analysis of social media scrutiny of Selena Gomez and celebrity body image
